# logto_application_secret

Owns one named secret on an existing Logto application. Logto generates the value;
Terraform stores it as a computed, sensitive attribute. Changing the application
ID or name replaces the resource. Import does not rotate the secret.

```hcl
resource "logto_application_secret" "grafana" {
  application_id = logto_application.grafana.id
  name           = "gitops"
}

output "grafana_client_secret" {
  value     = logto_application_secret.grafana.value
  sensitive = true
}
```

Import ID: `application-id/secret-name`. Application IDs and names cannot contain
`/`. This resource manages named secrets; it does not adopt the separate legacy
application secret. No expiry or explicit rotation policy is implemented yet.

Sensitive values remain in Terraform state: use an encrypted, restricted backend.
The Crossplane provider moves these values to connection Secrets instead of CRD
spec/status. Avoid using this Terraform resource and Crossplane to manage the same
external secret at the same time.
